note: GH-006 handle changed locator: a repository that moved is the same repository, and src/channels/refresh.zig separates location from identity so the lockfile's decision survives the move. Identity is checked before location, and the digest is the identity: a locator serving different bytes is refused however plausible its address and channel look, because 'the same package in a new place' and 'a different package in the old package's place' are the same observation from here and only the digest tells them apart. The channel is the authorization: identical bytes on a channel nobody granted are refused, because the bytes being right does not make the authorization right. A different package wearing the locked name is refused before either check. The test covers the unchanged locator, the moved locator with the same digest, a digest substitution, a channel change with identical bytes, and a package-name substitution. Fault proof: accepting any locator makes the substitution assertions fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
